goal: Restore the intended stop at every prologue episode ending so the player returns to Story Mode and explicitly starts the next episode.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting an episode-ending button persists the next episode start STEP and closes the tutorial overlay.
Story Mode is shown after each episode ending instead of rendering the next episode immediately.
The next episode remains available but does not start until the player selects it.
Ordinary dialogue STEP normalization does not create an episode break.
Save key, save fields, existing IDs, rewards, dialogue order, and game rules remain unchanged.
